items.text: Garden Party Pinball - full-size homebrew pinball machine using FAST hardware, MPF, coils, switches, lamps, cabinet wiring, and playfield revisions.

VividGrasp AI-Vision Robotics Arm - Stanford AI4ALL project built by a team of 10, connecting SolidWorks CAD, URDF/PyBullet simulation, target-based vision/control input, and robotic arm joint motion.
Smart Self-Watering Pot / Smart Planter PCB - moisture sensing, pump control, enclosure planning, and a custom PCB direction.
Subpix - open-source Electron/Vite/React/TypeScript desktop editor for .subpix files, RGB/BGR subpixel canvas editing, JSON validation, PNG export, and Windows installer packaging.
Check-ins - live Vercel app for logging consistency and tracking target/max gaps.
Desmos 3D Solar System - 3D math visualization using surfaces, orbits, color mapping, and performance-aware scene design.
TinyGPT Experiments - small next-token project for learning training vs. instruction behavior.
MIDI Practice Tool - Python music-practice utility for soundfonts, pedals, controls, and keyboard-style interaction.
3D printing - Bambu Studio, material choices, iteration prints, print orientation, and fit testing.
Laser cutting - design and fabrication planning for flat-cut parts and enclosures.
VEX V5 Drivetrain Prototype - robotics drivetrain build using gearing and packaging constraints around structure interference.
SolidWorks modeling - part design, assemblies, complex forms, and fabrication-oriented CAD decisions.
